```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(knitr)

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))

source("scripts/birdnet_cv_functions.R")

models <- c("sympatric_and_allopatric", "sympatric")
model_labels <- c(sympatric_and_allopatric = "Sympatric + allopatric", sympatric = "Sympatric only")

short <- function(x) ifelse(x == "Unassigned", x, sub("^(\\w)\\w+ ", "\\1. ", x))
```

# Purpose

- Train the two custom BirdNET classifiers from code, with a fixed random seed (123), so the fitting is reproducible
- Choose the hyperparameters and the classification thresholds, and estimate the performance of the classifiers, by 5-fold cross-validation grouped by recording
- Classify the vocalizations of other bellbirds and of the focal bellbird with models that never heard them

The two classifiers are:

- **Sympatric + allopatric**: the three sympatric species the bellbird could have imitated (Keel-billed Toucan, Collared Aracari and Montezuma Oropendola), their closely related allopatric species (Choco Toucan, Pale-mandibled Aracari and Chestnut-headed Oropendola) and the Three-wattled Bellbird
- **Sympatric only**: the three sympatric species and the Three-wattled Bellbird

# Data

2 s clips exported in [Data preparation](birdnet_acoustic_data_prep.qmd). All clips are used for cross-validation; each recording contributes several clips.

```{r data}
folds <- read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "folds.csv"))
clips <- aggregate(clip ~ species, folds, length)
names(clips) <- c("Species", "Clips")
clips$Recordings <- as.integer(tapply(folds$recording, folds$species, function(x) length(unique(x)))[clips$Species])
clips$Type <- ifelse(clips$Species %in% sympatric_spp, "Sympatric", "Allopatric")
clips$Type[clips$Species == "Procnias tricarunculatus"] <- "Bellbird"
clips[, c("Species", "Type", "Recordings", "Clips")]
```

# Cross-validation design

- The clips were split into 5 folds with a stratified group k-fold (seed 123): all clips of a recording fall in the same fold, and the folds are balanced by species. Five folds keep about 3 recordings of the species with fewest recordings (*P. guatimozinus*, 15) in each fold
- For each fold, the classifiers were trained on the other 4 folds and classified the held-out fold, so every clip has one out-of-fold prediction from a model that never heard its recording
- Training stops early on a random 20% of the training clips (the held-out fold is not used for training in any way), up to 50 epochs; the weights of the best epoch are kept
- Training and classification use a 400–12,000 Hz bandpass, BirdNET-Analyzer v2.4 and seed 123
- Three hyperparameter configurations were compared for each classifier:
    - **A**: 2,048 hidden units, dropout 0.5, batch size 64, learning rate 0.001, mixup and focal loss (α 0.75, γ 0.5)
    - **B**: 256 hidden units, dropout 0.5, batch size 16, learning rate 0.002, mixup and upsampling of the rare classes to 33% of the largest one
    - **C**: BirdNET defaults: linear classifier (no hidden layer), no dropout, batch size 32, learning rate 0.0001, no mixup, upsampling or focal loss
- The selection rule was set before looking at the results: the configuration with the highest macro-averaged AUPRC on the out-of-fold predictions (threshold-free), judged separately for each classifier
- Per-species thresholds are the ones that maximize F1 on the out-of-fold predictions (0.05 steps); a clip is assigned to the species with the highest confidence if it reaches that species' threshold, otherwise it is left unassigned

The whole pipeline is run with [`scripts/birdnet_cv.sh`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/birdnet_cv.sh). It assigns the folds with [`scripts/birdnet_cv_folds.py`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/birdnet_cv_folds.py) and trains through [`scripts/train_birdnet.py`](https://github.com/maRce10/bellbird_vocal_mimicry/blob/master/scripts/train_birdnet.py), a wrapper of BirdNET-Analyzer that seeds Python, NumPy and TensorFlow (weights, shuffling, dropout, mixup), turns on deterministic TensorFlow operations and saves the training history. Re-running the training with the same seed gives the same models up to floating-point rounding.

```{bash cv}
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: false

# from the project root
bash scripts/birdnet_cv.sh all   # folds, 30 trainings (3 configurations x 2 classifiers x 5 folds) and classifications
```

```{r cv setup}
cv_res <- list()
for (cf in configs) for (m in models) {
    sc <- oof_scores(cf, m, folds)
    spp <- model_spp[[m]]
    thr <- optimal_thresholds(sc, spp)
    cv_res[[cf]][[m]] <- list(scores = sc, thr = thr, metrics = cv_metrics(sc, spp, thr),
                              folds = fold_metrics(sc, spp, thr))
}
```

## Folds

```{r folds table}
ft <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(folds$species, folds$fold))
names(ft) <- paste("Fold", names(ft))
rec <- tapply(paste(folds$species, folds$recording), folds$fold, function(x) length(unique(x)))
rbind(ft, Recordings = as.integer(rec), `Total clips` = colSums(ft))
```

# Comparison of configurations

Out-of-fold macro-averaged AUPRC and F1 (thresholds from the out-of-fold predictions). Error bars: standard deviation across folds.

```{r cv comparison}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5

cmp_cv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(configs, function(cf) do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) {
    r <- cv_res[[cf]][[m]]
    data.frame(Model = model_labels[[m]], Configuration = cf,
               AUPRC = r$metrics$macro[["AUPRC"]], `AUPRC SD` = sd(r$folds$AUPRC),
               F1 = r$metrics$macro[["F1"]], `F1 SD` = sd(r$folds$F1),
               Accuracy = r$metrics$macro[["accuracy"]], check.names = FALSE)
}))))
cmp_cv$Model <- factor(cmp_cv$Model, levels = model_labels)
best_cfg <- sapply(models, function(m) {
    d <- cmp_cv[cmp_cv$Model == model_labels[[m]], ]
    d$Configuration[order(-d$AUPRC, -d$F1)[1]]
})
cmp_cv$Selected <- ifelse(cmp_cv$Configuration == best_cfg[match(cmp_cv$Model, model_labels)], "✓", "")

long <- rbind(data.frame(cmp_cv[, c("Model", "Configuration")], metric = "Macro AUPRC", value = cmp_cv$AUPRC, sd = cmp_cv$`AUPRC SD`),
              data.frame(cmp_cv[, c("Model", "Configuration")], metric = "Macro F1", value = cmp_cv$F1, sd = cmp_cv$`F1 SD`))
ggplot(long, aes(Configuration, value, color = Configuration)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = value - sd, ymax = value + sd), size = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +
    facet_grid(metric ~ Model, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.8, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Configuration", y = "") +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank())

kable(cmp_cv[order(cmp_cv$Model), ], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

Selected configurations: **`r best_cfg[["sympatric_and_allopatric"]]`** for the sympatric + allopatric classifier and **`r best_cfg[["sympatric"]]`** for the sympatric-only classifier. The differences between configurations are small compared with the variation across folds.

## Training history of the selected configurations

Each line is one fold. Validation: the random 20% of the training clips used for early stopping.

```{r training history}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

hist <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) do.call(rbind, lapply(1:5, function(k) {
    h <- read.csv(file.path(cv_dir, "models", best_cfg[[m]], m, paste0("fold_", k), paste0(m, "_history.csv")))
    data.frame(model = paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")"), fold = k,
               epoch = rep(h$epoch, 4),
               metric = rep(c("Loss", "Loss", "AUPRC", "AUPRC"), each = nrow(h)),
               set = rep(c("Training", "Validation", "Training", "Validation"), each = nrow(h)),
               value = c(h$loss, h$val_loss, h$AUPRC, h$val_AUPRC))
}))))
hist$model <- factor(hist$model, levels = unique(hist$model))

ggplot(hist, aes(epoch, value, color = set, group = interaction(set, fold))) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(metric ~ model, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.7, name = "") +
    labs(x = "Epoch", y = "") +
    theme(legend.position = "top", strip.background = element_blank())
```

# Performance of the selected configurations

```{r cv per species}
#| results: asis

for (m in models) {
    r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]]
    ps <- r$metrics$per_species
    names(ps) <- c("Species", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "AUPRC", "Threshold", "Clips")
    cat("\n\n##", model_labels[[m]], "(configuration", best_cfg[[m]], ")\n\n")
    print(kable(ps, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE))
}
```

## Confusion matrices

```{r cv confusion}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

cv_conf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) {
    r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]]
    tb <- as.data.frame(table(true = r$scores$true, predicted = r$metrics$pred))
    tb$prop <- tb$Freq / ave(tb$Freq, tb$true, FUN = sum)
    tb$model <- paste0(model_labels[[m]], " (", best_cfg[[m]], ")")
    tb
}))
cv_conf$model <- factor(cv_conf$model, levels = unique(cv_conf$model))
cv_conf$true <- short(as.character(cv_conf$true))
cv_conf$predicted <- short(as.character(cv_conf$predicted))

ggplot(cv_conf, aes(predicted, true, fill = prop)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Freq > 0, Freq, "")), size = 3.5,
              color = ifelse(cv_conf$prop > 0.5, "black", "white")) +
    facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", limits = c(0, 1), name = "Proportion\nof true class") +
    labs(x = "Predicted", y = "True", title = "Out-of-fold predictions") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), strip.background = element_blank())
```

## Other bellbirds

Every recording of other bellbirds gets an out-of-fold prediction, so the control uses all `r sum(folds$species == "Procnias tricarunculatus")` bellbird clips.

```{r cv other bellbirds}
ob <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) {
    r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]]
    p <- r$metrics$pred[r$scores$true == "Procnias tricarunculatus"]
    data.frame(Model = model_labels[[m]], `Classified as` = names(table(p)), Clips = as.integer(table(p)), check.names = FALSE)
}))
ob
```

# Focal bellbird classification

The `r length(list.files("./data/processed/birdnet_data/mimic_bellbird"))` focal bellbird clips are classified with the 5 fold models of the selected configuration: the confidence of each species is averaged across the 5 models (ensemble) and the out-of-fold thresholds are applied. The predictions are saved in `data/processed/birdnet_cv/focal_predictions_<model>.csv`, and the out-of-fold predictions of the reference clips in `data/processed/birdnet_cv/oof_predictions_<model>.csv`; both are used in the [statistical analysis](statistical_analysis_cv.qmd).

```{r cv focal}
focal_cv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(m) {
    cf <- best_cfg[[m]]
    en <- ensemble_scores(cf, m)
    en$predicted <- assign_species(en, model_spp[[m]], cv_res[[cf]][[m]]$thr)
    write.csv(en, file.path(cv_dir, paste0("focal_predictions_", m, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    data.frame(model = model_labels[[m]], predicted = en$predicted)
}))

# out-of-fold predictions of the reference clips, for downstream use
for (m in models) {
    r <- cv_res[[best_cfg[[m]]]][[m]]
    write.csv(data.frame(r$scores, predicted = r$metrics$pred, check.names = FALSE),
              file.path(cv_dir, paste0("oof_predictions_", m, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

fc_tab <- as.data.frame(table(focal_cv$model, focal_cv$predicted))
names(fc_tab) <- c("Model", "Classified as", "Clips")
fc_tab[fc_tab$Clips > 0, ]
```

```{r focal plot}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

fp <- fc_tab[fc_tab$Clips > 0, ]
fp$`Classified as` <- short(as.character(fp$`Classified as`))
ggplot(fp, aes(`Classified as`, Clips, fill = Model)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"), width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(end = 0.6, name = "") +
    labs(x = "", y = "Focal bellbird clips") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"), legend.position = "top")
```

```{r cv sympatric share}
sa <- focal_cv[focal_cv$model == model_labels[["sympatric_and_allopatric"]], "predicted"]
allo <- c("Psarocolius guatimozinus", "Pteroglossus erythropygius", "Ramphastos brevis")
symp_het <- setdiff(sympatric_spp, "Procnias tricarunculatus")
sh <- c(Sympatric = sum(sa %in% symp_het), Allopatric = sum(sa %in% allo))
data.frame(t(sh), `% sympatric` = round(100 * sh[[1]] / sum(sh), 1),
           `Sympatric : allopatric` = round(sh[[1]] / sh[[2]], 1), check.names = FALSE)
```

# Takeaways

- Both classifiers were trained from code with a fixed seed (123); re-running gives the same models up to floating-point rounding
- 5-fold cross-validation grouped by recording selected configuration `r best_cfg[["sympatric_and_allopatric"]]` for the sympatric + allopatric classifier (out-of-fold macro AUPRC `r sprintf("%.3f", cmp_cv$AUPRC[cmp_cv$Selected == "✓" & cmp_cv$Model == model_labels[["sympatric_and_allopatric"]]])`) and `r best_cfg[["sympatric"]]` for the sympatric-only classifier (`r sprintf("%.3f", cmp_cv$AUPRC[cmp_cv$Selected == "✓" & cmp_cv$Model == model_labels[["sympatric"]]])`); differences between configurations are within fold-to-fold variation
- The weakest classes are the aracaris and the oropendolas in the sympatric + allopatric classifier, where each is confused with its close relative (*P. torquatus* with *P. erythropygius* above all); in the sympatric-only classifier all species have F1 > 0.92
- Other bellbirds were rarely classified as another species (out-of-fold predictions of all their recordings)
- `r sh[["Sympatric"]]` focal bellbird clips were classified as a sympatric species and `r sh[["Allopatric"]]` as an allopatric one (`r round(sh[["Sympatric"]] / sh[["Allopatric"]], 1)` : 1)
